summary: Phase 2 ENERGY frontend E2E validation (admin + read-only tenant). All critical flows pass: /energie renders with 4 KPIs showing cents (74.17 CHF, no NaN/Invalid Date/undefined); the real MIGROL SERVICE row (12.06.2026 14:32 · Essence · 43,12 L · 1.720 CHF/L · 74.17 CHF) is present exactly once; vehicle filter narrows to Enyaq and persists KPIs; empty state renders for vehicles without transactions; drawer 'Énergie' tab opens via energy-vehicle-<id> click with vehicle-energy-list showing the MIGROL line; Coûts page shows the Migrol cost line exactly once (0 occurrences of 148.34); seeded duplicate ticket flow triggers DuplicateSuspectedBox (data-kind='transaction', title 'Transaction énergie en doublon probable'), 'Valider quand même' button creates exactly 1 fuel_transaction then success toast; delete of ticket_essence.jpg (source of a transaction) is blocked with HTTP 409 and toast message 'Ce document est la pièce justificative d'une transaction énergie — suppression impossible pour préserver la traçabilité.'; read_only user ro-e2e sees empty /energie, no MIGROL leak (tenant isolation OK); mobile 390x844 renders 2-col KPI grid, row scrollable, no NaN; no unexpected 4xx/5xx (only the deliberate 409s on delete + duplicate validate); no console errors apart from logs of those 409 responses. All test artefacts cleaned up (seeded doc + its fuel_transaction removed via Mongo deleteOne).
